question: Does importing the public State from a proven deterministic native snapshot reproduce its nominal trajectory, and can an older public State yield repeatable nominal dynamics under the same worker options?

runtime.device: cuda:0 on the same GPU architecture as the native retry

preflight: Validate hashes, seed, asset layout, archive config, Backend options, clock and static nominal controller commands.

Decode the saved native snapshot as its original schema. Verify declared array names, shapes and finite dtype conversion against a fresh scene template. Reconstitute tuple and dataclass fields, restore both buffers, and compare observed public state, clocks, counters and controller before stepping.

Reuse the earlier public-State importer with a fresh deterministic scene template and statically derived qdd and filter state. Preserve zero time for initializer physics and check every transition of each branch.
procedure: Load the saved same-configuration native snapshot at tick 168. Run two nominal native restores and compare to each other and the two recorded native branches. The saved snapshot avoids another nominal physics prefix.

Import the public State from the saved snapshot, then run two nominal restores. Compare all same-session native and reconstructed branches with the frozen live same-run numerical, control, retention and H32 position gates.

If those pass, import archived validation_lateral tick 168 State and run two nominal branches. Compare and report their H8/H16/H32 half spreads with the original archive replays as context from a different solver configuration. This is an import and repeatability check; cross-configuration differences are reported separately and cannot establish whether the imported archive trajectory matches its original dynamics.

gates.before_step: Match discrete fields and lead clock; position <= 1e-6 m, quaternion geodesic <= 1e-5 rad, linear velocity <= 1e-5 m/s, angular velocity <= 1e-5 rad/s; controller q/qd and tilt/rate match archived state. Report native and derived arrays or explicit use and derivation.
gates.native_reference: Compare both new native branches with both previously recorded same-configuration branches; require the same numerical, controls/retention and H32 half-spread ceilings before using either import.
gates.same_configuration: Require identical controls, timing and retention classes and maximum tool-frame position, linear speed and spin component differences <= 1e-5 m, 1e-3 m/s and 2e-2 rad/s. Require across-source H32 position half spread <= 1e-6 m. Retain H8/H16 evidence.
gates.historical_same_session: Repeatability uses the same numerical ceilings and <=1e-6 m half spread at H8/H16/H32; separately report divergence from the old configuration. Perturbed or scalar objective tests require independent acceptance.

stop_conditions: Frozen input, layout, replay or pre-step equivalence failure
